KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda (kecuali teksi

dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda (kecuali bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (kecuali bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesebuah kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah termasuk sebagai

sebahagian daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Menteri Kerja Raya

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS) (NORTH SOUTH

EXPRESSWAY CENTRAL LINK AND KLIA EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This Order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (North South Expressway Central Link and KLIA Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2014.

(2) Subparagraph 2(c) and paragraphs 4 and 5 come into operation on

9 January 2014.

(3) Subparagraphs 2(a) and (b) are deemed to have come into operation on

12 January 2012.

(4) Subsubparagraph 3(a)(i) and subparagraph 3(b) is deemed to have come

into operation on 1 January 2010.

(5) Subsubparagraph 3(a)(ii) is deemed to have come into operation on

15 January 2011.

(6) Imposition and collection of toll rates―

(a) for class 1 to class 4 as specified in Part B of the Third Schedule are

from 14 July 2009 until 31 December 2015; and

(b) for class 5 as specified in Part B of the Third Schedule:―

(i) from 14 July 2009 until 14 January 2011 is at the rate

specified in the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (North South Expressway Central Link

and KLIA Expressway) (Amendment) (No. 3) Order 2009

[P.U. (A) 252/2009]; and

(ii) from 15 January 2011 until 31 December 2015 is as

specified in subsubparagraph 3(a)(ii) of this Order.

Amendment of paragraph 3

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (North South

Expressway Central Link and KLIA Expressway) Order 2002 [P.U. (A) 437/2002] which

is referred to as the "principle Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 3(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "Expressway Lingkaran Tengah Sendirian

Berhad" the words "Projek Lebuhraya Usahasama Berhad";

(b) by substituting for the words "31 May 2030" the words

"31 December 2038"; and

(c) by substituting for the words "Eleventh Schedule" wherever appearing

the words "Third Schedule A".

Amendment of Third Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended in the Third Schedule—

(a) in PART B—

(i) in title, by substituting for the words "31 December 2009"

the words "31 Disember 2015"; and

(ii) by substituting for column Class 5 the following column:
